fields.name: Ripple Breathing
fields.description: +1d to resist poison, fatigue, or fear. Once per score, push yourself with no stress cost.

fields.name: Scarlet Overdrive
fields.description: Ignite a weapon or limb. Inflicts a fire-based secondary effect. Foes must resist or catch fire. Gains +1 effect vs vampires and pillarmen.

fields.name: Zoom Punch
fields.description: Make a melee strike up to 15ft. +1d when attacking from unexpected angles or cover.

fields.name: Acrobatic Pulse
fields.description: Gain stable footing and the ability to run over bodies of water, mist, unstable surfaces, or vertical walls. +1d to climbing, jumping, swimming, running, or vaulting.

fields.name: Vital Transfer
fields.description: Use Tinker or Bizarre to make an action roll to heal an ally. Mark a number of segments on your healing clock. 1-3: one segment, 4/5: two segments, 6: three segments, critical: five segments.

fields.name: Ripple Hypnosis
fields.description: Make a Bizarre action roll to hypnotize a victim. You may extract a vivid set of memories, or force the victim to attack or perform an action once. You must continue to uphold concentration in order to make them perform multiple actions or to maintain their action.

fields.name: Ripple Deflect
fields.description: You gain 1 Hamon Armor charge. Use this charge to reflect a projectile attack back towards the opponent. The projectile is imbued with Hamon. Pay 2 stress to regain the charge.

fields.name: Ripple Locator
fields.description: Using the environment around you (dust, water in a container, etc.), you gain +1d to locate objects or entities.

fields.name: Sendō Overdrive
fields.description: Strike targets through walls or barriers up to 65ft. Cannot conduct Hamon through metallic objects.

fields.name: Metal Silver Overdrive
fields.description: Ripple conducts through metallic objects (Sendo Overdrive upgrade)

fields.name: Age Resistance
fields.description: Once per session, ignore 1 fatigue, aging, or time-based consequence.

fields.name: Life Magnetism Overdrive
fields.description: Your expertise with Hamon allows you to manipulate faint magnetic fields that originate from organic life. Spend 1 stress to stick/shape organic matter together. Example: shape plant matter into a glider, cloak, or shield. +1 effect on movement or defensive action rolls.

fields.name: Tornado Overdrive
fields.description: Your expertise in Hamon allows you to jump up to 20ft mid air, and up to 30ft horizontally. While in air, perform a high-speed rotational dive. The impact causes a shockwave of Hamon to scar the area.

fields.name: Aura Lock
fields.description: Spend 2 stress to suppress an opponent's ability activation within your range until the target pushes themselves or the fiction shifts.

fields.name: Final Flame
fields.description: When you would be taken out, you may spend 2 stress to take one final action with +1 effect. You fall unconscious immediately after.

fields.name: Pulse Detonation
fields.description: Channel stored Ripple into an AoE knockdown within your operational Range. Fill a 4-tick "Crowd Disruption" clock.

fields.name: Ripple Cutter
fields.description: Transfer Hamon into liquids; attacks using Hamon infused liquid gain +1 effect towards steel structures.

fields.name: Sunlight Yellow Overdrive
fields.description: Sacrifice all remaining stress to oneshot an undead entity. The undead entity explodes with a surging Hamon shockwave, affecting foes up to 20ft radius.

fields.name: Deep Pass Overdrive
fields.description: If your character dies, you have the opportunity to sacrifice all remaining stress to fully heal an ally, as well as transferring all of your knowledge (including Hamon techniques) to them. They gain +1d to all actions and +1 effect to Hamon based actions until the end of the session.

fields.name: Turquoise Blue Overdrive
fields.description: Attacking with Hamon while in a body of water may create a tempest/giant waves. The body of water loses half of its water for each use.

fields.name: Time Ripple
fields.description: Once a day, you may roll two d6's. You may substitute the outcome of any roll with these dice.

fields.name: Guided Overdrive
fields.description: Ripple arcs from your primary target to a second target within 30ft. The second target takes splash damage.

fields.name: Bubble Launcher
fields.description: Fire a barrage of Hamon-charged bubbles within your operational Range. You may detonate them at will.

fields.name: Reflection Pulse
fields.description: Bounce an attack or ability through three or more bubble surfaces.

fields.name: Hamon Mirage
fields.description: Use bubble refraction to hide your location or identity until you attack, take Harm, or the fiction exposes you.

fields.name: Bubble Laser Grid
fields.description: Set up a refracted beam of Hamon infused light that passes through bubbles within your operational Range.

fields.name: Trick Bubble
fields.description: Store an attack or effect in a bubble. Declare a condition now — the effect triggers when that condition is met.

fields.name: Echo Feint
fields.description: Leave behind a reflective bubble afterimage within your immediate presence. The next attack against you targets the illusion instead.

fields.name: Pulse Core
fields.description: Your cybernetic enhancement allows you to generate Hamon without breathing.

fields.name: Neural Sync
fields.description: Spend 1 stress to seize control or short out a nearby machine within your immediate presence. Roll Tinker or Command to determine precision.

fields.name: Shockline
fields.description: When an enemy hits you, expend an armor charge to discharge an electric shock back towards the opponent.

fields.name: EMP Burst
fields.description: Once per score, disable all tech within your immediate presence. Starts a 5-tick "Blackout" clock. Your cybernetics are immune to this effect.

fields.name: Circuit Burn
fields.description: Disable an enemy's gear or weapon until they push themselves to reactivate it.

fields.name: Thermal Control
fields.description: Superheat or supercool any surface you can touch.

fields.name: Blood Freeze
fields.description: Touch attack slows blood flow. Target cannot move without pushing themselves. On a success, start a 4-tick "Crystallization" clock — on completion, they are fully immobilized. Enemies must make fortune saves to free themselves.

fields.name: Shadow Pulse
fields.description: Emit an aura that snuffs light and distorts senses. +1d to Prowl in dim or dark areas.

fields.name: Frozen Fate
fields.description: When you would take fatal Harm, encase yourself in ice instead. Avoid all damage. Once per score.

fields.name: Grave Pulse
fields.description: Touch a corpse or undead to reanimate it briefly. It acts for one action under your direction, then crumbles.

fields.name: Aura Extinguish
fields.description: Spend 3 stress to touch and suppress all auras (Stands, Spin, Hamon) within your immediate presence. Victims must roll a fortune roll to regain composure.

fields.name: Soul Leech
fields.description: When you take out a foe with Vampiric Style, regain 2 stress. Once per score.
